install.summary: For Hermes Desktop on Windows/macOS, prefer the official desktop installer. Plain install.ps1 / install.sh installs the CLI; include the desktop flag when the GUI is required.
install.windows_download: Download the Windows installer linked at https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/desktop and run it. It provisions the CLI and desktop app.
install.macos_download: Download the macOS installer linked at https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/desktop (macOS 12+).
install.note: The official bootstrapper provisions its own dependencies. Their versions and layout vary by platform; do not force Node 22 or skip managed uv based on an unrelated system installation. Non-Windows script installs need Git; Linux also needs curl and xz-utils, plus g++ / build-essential for desktop native modules. Desktop builds and later browser-tool downloads still depend on their upstream hosts. Fetching the first script does not prove every download will succeed.

cli.note: The CLI and Desktop are separate verification targets. `hermes desktop` builds and launches the GUI from an existing CLI installation.

install_flow.summary: Use the desktop installer or a script with the desktop flag → verify CLI and desktop separately.
agent_steps: Detect the target OS and architecture. Install a GUI on a machine with a desktop session; a requested headless server install uses the CLI-only path.

Windows/macOS: prefer the official desktop installer linked from the product page. Tell the user its download path and open it for them. Windows script alternative: use the scriptblock command with -IncludeDesktop; appending the flag to iex does not pass it to the downloaded script.
Linux: check Git, curl, xz-utils and the desktop compiler prerequisites, then use install.sh with --include-desktop. For an existing CLI install, `hermes desktop` builds and launches the GUI.

Inspect the installer result. If it fails, report the failing host or stage and use the user’s proxy or an approved package mirror for that dependency. Keep the official bootstrapper and its managed dependency layout. Do not replace repository URLs globally or choose an arbitrary GitHub proxy.
Verify `hermes --version`. If Desktop was requested, also verify its application entry or built desktop artifact exists and opens; a CLI version alone does not confirm Desktop installation.
Report the actual installed location and launch command (`hermes desktop` for the GUI).
tell_user: Whether both CLI and Desktop were verified
Any unfinished interactive installer step or failed dependency download

network_requirements.note: Dependency downloads can fail independently. Diagnose the actual failing stage; use session-scoped proxy or approved mirror settings and retain the official installer.
